Creating and saving region projection results plots to PDF files

Source: R/wrappers.R
save_plots_regions_all.Rd

Method for generating and saving plots of MRC projection results for all regions. Outputs can be saved either as: (a) a single combined PDF file containing all regions, or (b) separate PDF files for each region.

Usage

save_plots_regions_all(
  projection_object,
  single_file = FALSE,
  order_by_name = FALSE,
  show_post_switch = TRUE,
  folder,
  demographic_plots = TRUE,
  switching_plots,
  migration_plots,
  plot_colors = c("blue3", "green4", "red3", "yellow3", "orange3", "purple3", "grey40"),
  plot_switching_colors = c("blue3", "green4", "red3", "yellow3", "orange3", "purple3",
    "grey40", "darkblue", "darkgreen", "red4", "yellow4", "orange4", "purple4", "grey30"),
  progress_bar = TRUE
)

Arguments

projection_object

Projection_object; a resolved projection object containing completed results to visualize.

single_file

Logical; if TRUE, saves all region plots into a single .pdf file (default FALSE).

order_by_name

Logical; if TRUE, regions are ordered alphabetically by name; if FALSE, by code (default FALSE).

show_post_switch

Logical; if FALSE, combines post-switch and non-switch populations into a single category in the plots (default TRUE).

folder

Character; name of the folder in which results should be saved. Defaults to projection_object's name.

demographic_plots

Logical; if FALSE, skips creation of fertility and mortality plots (default TRUE).

switching_plots

Logical; if FALSE, skips creation of switching plots. Defaults to the projection's switching status.

migration_plots

Logical; if FALSE, skips creation of migration plots. Defaults to the projection's migration status.

plot_colors

Character vector; colors used for each religion in the plots (default: 7-color palette).

plot_switching_colors

Character vector; colors used for post-switch religious groups in the plots (default: 14-color palette).

progress_bar

Logical; whether to show a progress bar and ETA (default TRUE).

Value

Called for its side effects. Saves region plots as PDF file(s) to `folder` and prints a completion message.

See also

save_plots_all for country-level plots, save_plots_comparative_all to compare scenarios. vignette("visualising-projections") for a complete guide including which variants each flag controls.

Examples

# Running a full projection is time-consuming.
# Wrapped in dontrun to avoid executing during documentation build.
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
obj <- test_object_generator(object_name = "example")
project(projection_object = obj, progress_bar = FALSE, save_totals = TRUE)
save_plots_regions_all(projection_object = obj, folder = tempdir(), progress_bar = FALSE)
} # }
